svg.title: Palavras em Movimento
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Palavras em Movimento.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached illustration ONLY as the shared STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: premium detailed pixel art, crisp small pixels, subtle dithering, dimensional light, richly layered cozy Brazilian town adventure art. Retain the SAME Black teenage heroine with dark brown skin, voluminous short curly afro hair, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE wholly NEW finished VOICES game-selection cover depicting the described different challenge; replace the entire scene and character pose. Wide 20:9 landscape (approximately 1870x841), edge-to-edge key art for a 640x288 card. Clear readable action at thumbnail size; main subjects within the central 75 percent height. No lettering, text, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, interface, HUD, borders, screenshot look, photorealism, toy 3D or smooth vector illustration. Challenge: Palavras em Movimento. A lively SIDE-SCROLLING platform adventure at a warm bustling market street. Show the heroine in an unmistakable airborne jumping pose crossing from one moss-edged wooden raised platform toward a higher platform. Three distinct staggered platforms dominate the lower and middle composition. A floating luminous open book hovers above the destination platform, with a few golden collectible coins tracing the jump arc. At the far right, a small jade-green exit doorway glows invitingly; a compact friendly-looking purple and brass archive sentry made from book-like shapes patrols on the ground beneath, separated from the heroine. Rich tiled-roof market stalls with striped ochre and cream awnings, produce crates, leafy trees and Brazilian town facades in the background. Clear physically readable jump, platforms, book and portal, energetic but cozy. Honey sunlight, teal and sage, terracotta and gold, lavender character. No three-lane road, no rhythm track, no HUD or text."}
